subject: gk
question: Which of the following is NOT an objective of diet therapy?

options.text: Promotion of recovery formulation of the diet to meet the needs of the patient taking into consideration her or his food habits
Correction of nutritional deficiencies; if any
Education and counselling of the patient regarding the need to adhere to the prescribed diet.
Use of unrefined grains for diet control programme.

solution:
The correct answer is "__**Use of unrefined grains for diet control program**__".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **u**____**se of unrefined grains for diet control programme**__ is __**NOT**__ an __**objective of diet therapy**__.
 
• The **objectives** of **diet therapy** are as follows:
 __
 
• To **modify** the diet to better suit the body's utilization of specific foods.
 
• To have a certain **result** as a **treatment**, to fill in nutritional gaps with food high in a specific ingredient.
 
• Correcting any dietary inadequacies already present and keeping the patient in good **nutritional condition**.
 
• Formulating a diet to fit the **patient's needs** while taking into account their eating habits will aid in their **rehabilitation**.
 
• **Patient coaching **and education on the significance of following the **recommended diet.**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Diet therapy** is a general term for the use of diet in **clinical practice** to treat or prevent disease.
 
• It focuses on **disease prevention** and illness recuperation through a healthy diet.
 
• It can entail changing the current **dietary lifestyle** to support the best possible health.
